;; REPEAT capture lifetimes (R13/R14, decision D9).
;; `outer` declares the variable outside REPEAT: the first iteration binds
;; it and later iterations are equality tests, so only the first-bound
;; letter can keep moving.  `inner` declares it inside REPEAT: every
;; iteration is a fresh invocation, so all letters pack rightward.

GOAL
Z

A-B-

BIND o outer "bind outside repeat" i inner "bind inside repeat"

CMD outer
 ATOMIC 1 AB
  REPEAT
   1- -1

CMD inner
 REPEAT
  ATOMIC 1 AB
   1- -1
